gap.title: No run of clause learning by unit propagation refutes the pigeonhole formula with 4 holes and one more pigeon learning at most 12 clauses
gap.statement: ¬ (∃ ρ : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin (4 + 1) × Fin 4)), PEqualNP.Search.IsRUPRun (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PHP (4 + 1) 4) ρ ∧ (∅ : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin (4 + 1) × Fin 4)) ∈ ρ ∧ ρ.length ≤ 12)
